description: VN→ZH classifier over-generalization (辆 family): Vietnamese learners default to 个, but wheeled vehicles (车/自行车/汽车/公交车/卡车) take 辆. Rule zh-ge-to-liang rewrites 个 → 辆 for a closed vehicle noun.
fp_risk_note: Low risk. Rewrites 个 → 辆 only before a closed wheeled-vehicle noun (车/自行车/汽车/公交车/卡车) after a number/demonstrative. Compounds where 车 is not the counted head (车站/车库/车间/车票/车祸/车轮) are guarded by a tail lookahead.

positive.notes: 一个自行车 → 一辆自行车 (multi-char vehicle noun).
那个汽车 → 那辆汽车 (demonstrative).

negative.notes: 人 genuinely takes 个 — not in the map, must abstain.
车站 (station) — 车 is not the counted head, the 站 tail lookahead guards it, must abstain.
